paper_title: Operation of a ferromagnetic axion haloscope at $m_a=58\,μ$eV
notes: QUAX ferromagnetic haloscope (GaYIG spheres in 14 GHz cavity). Upper limit g_aee < 4.9e-10 at 95% C.L. for m_a = 58 ueV (14 GHz), from resonant axion-electron spin interaction. A limited ~3 MHz frequency scan was performed around 14 GHz; the minimum value 4.9e-10 occurs at the central frequency. Local DM density 0.45 GeV/cm^3 assumed. DFSZ axion-electron coupling constrained. | selector: text (sole candidate)
